confidence_notes: Food estimates use Marmaris cost-of-living aggregates, but the city data are sparse and July resort pricing varies. Cocktail is estimated at roughly twice the local draft-beer price; wine by the glass uses its local price relationship to beer. Accommodation is a holistic July high-season estimate, not based on live listings.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink are based on Marmaris city price data; accommodation reflects a southwestern Turkish Aegean resort in July.
